verdict.rationale: Postman's docs include dedicated Variables and Environments pages, including 'managing-environments'. A community user independently says Postman is 'invaluable for testing/validating APIs across environments', and another refers to a stored QA environment with test keys. Together these confirm that environment variable sets are a first-party feature used to target different deployments. Missing for 10: in-pack documentation detail on actually switching the active environment per request, and explicit coverage of dev/staging/prod workflows beyond link titles.
